nodes.text:
Brrr, feeling under the weather? 🤧 It could be more than just a cold! Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is circulating, and it's important to be aware.

🤔 It can cause similar symptoms to a cold or flu, but can be more serious for certain groups. #HMPV #RespiratoryVirus

nodes.author: sauravyadav526
nodes.text:
What are the symptoms? 🤔 Think cough, runny nose, fever, sore throat, and sometimes wheezing or difficulty breathing. 😮‍💨 In severe cases, especially in young children, older adults, and people with weakened immune systems, HMPV can lead to bronchitis or pneumonia.

🫁 #HMPV

nodes.author: sauravyadav526
nodes.text:
How does HMPV spread? 🦠 Just like other respiratory viruses, it spreads through respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs or sneezes.
🗣️ Coughing and sneezing into your elbow or a tissue is super important! 🤧➡️💪 Washing hands frequently also helps prevent spread. 🧼

nodes.author: sauravyadav526
nodes.text:
Who is most at risk? 👶 Older adults, young children (especially under 5), and people with weakened immune systems or underlying lung or heart conditions are at higher risk of developing severe complications from HMPV.

🧓👵👶 #HMPVRiskGroups #VulnerablePopulations #HealthMatters

nodes.author: sauravyadav526
nodes.text: There's no specific antiviral treatment for HMPV, but most cases resolve on their own with rest, fluids, and over-the-counter medications to manage symptoms. 🛌💧💊 If you're concerned about your symptoms or are in a high-risk group, please consult a healthcare professional. 👩‍⚕️
